name: Remove Malady
body:
School abjuration [pact]; Level bard 3, cleric 3, druid 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (inscribed spoon worth 100 gp x the malady’s DC)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target touched creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Remove malady attempts to remove a single pact malady active on the touched creature. In order to remove a malady, the caster must succeed on a caster level check (DC equals 10 + the spirit’s level + the number of days the subject has been inflicted with the malady). Success immediately removes the malady.

Certain maladies may not be removable with this spell.

Remove malady counters and dispels bestow pact malady†.
